name: Bazarr
description: Auto-update ON by default (6h); unzips GitHub zip over live install, restarts. No hash/sig.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Bazarr checks GitHub releases and selects a bazarr.zip asset; the reviewed source does not independently establish archive verification or the complete live-install restart path.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; released artifact behavior may differ.

original_evidence.text: | Bazarr | morpheus65535/bazarr | Python (Flask + APScheduler) | Y | chk/dl/inst fully automatic — `settings.general.auto_update` defaults to `True`, `check_if_new_update` runs on a 6-hour APScheduler interval with no user interaction | Y (downloads `bazarr.zip` from a GitHub release asset and unzips it directly over the running install tree, then calls `webserver.restart()` — this loads unreviewed/unverified Python source into the running app) | https, `https://api.github.com/repos/morpheus65535/Bazarr/releases` and the release's `browser_download_url` (GitHub-hosted); TLS validation enforced by default — plain `requests.get(...)` calls with no `verify=False` anywhere in check_update.py | no (GitHub Releases API JSON is unsigned) | none — no hash, checksum, or signature check anywhere in `download_release`/`apply_update` before files are extracted over the install directory | n/a | bazarr/app/check_update.py:30 (`url_releases = 'https://api.github.com/repos/morpheus65535/Bazarr/releases...'`), :121-137 (`download_release`, plain `requests.get`, no integrity check), :140-207 (`apply_update`, unzip straight into `bazarr_dir` then `webserver.restart()`); bazarr/app/config.py:97 (`'general.auto_update', default=True`); bazarr/app/scheduler.py:283-285 (`check_if_new_update` on 6h interval when `auto_update` true) |
